slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other requirements or constraints not mentioned in the brief, such as minimum purchase quantities, demand forecasts, or restrictions on when purchases can be made?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched purchase timing by asking about restrictions on when purchases can be made, but it did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning/start of the month or how that timing affects intra-month inventory. The specific beginning-of-month fact came from the user's answer to a broad catch-all question.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after only a vague catch-all had touched purchase timing, leaving the P1 intra-month purchase-timing slot not explicitly confirmed by a targeted question.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and several boundary constraints, but its only coverage of purchase timing was a broad catch-all rather than a targeted question, so the P1 hidden slot was only partially recovered before READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
